smallPrint.heading: How billing works
smallPrint.currency: Prices are in euros and include VAT.
smallPrint.pass: A Single Exam Pass is paid once. Its six months start when your payment is confirmed, and it ends on the date shown in your account. It never renews and is never charged again.
smallPrint.renewal: Plus renews every month or every year until you cancel. The yearly price is charged in full at the start of each year. Cancel any time from your account; Plus stays on until the end of the period you paid for.
smallPrint.withdrawal: Access starts as soon as you pay. At checkout you are asked to confirm that you want it straight away and that the 14-day right of withdrawal ends when it starts.
smallPrint.cards: Card details are entered in fields provided by Stripe, our payment provider, and go straight to Stripe. They never reach our servers.
smallPrint.earlier: A plan bought before these prices keeps everything it included, at its price, until it ends. We do not move anyone to a new plan or price without telling them first.
